observations: Photo 0 shows a black PlayStation 4 console with a blue light on the front, placed on a black surface with a black DualShock 4 controller in front of it. A TV screen is visible to the left, showing a blue screen.

Photo 1 shows a larger box labeled 'SONY PS4' with an image of the console and two DualShock 4 controllers. The console is placed in front of the box, and the box appears to be a retail or promotional one, not a used one.
The console in both photos has the 'PS4' logo visible on the front right side.
The controller in photo 0 has the standard PlayStation button layout: D-pad, analog sticks, touchpad, and four action buttons (triangle, circle, cross, square).
The console in photo 1 appears to be a different model or a different angle of the same console, but the 'PS4' branding is still visible.
No games, cables, or accessories are visible in either photo.
The seller claims '7 games pad' — likely meaning 7 games and 1 controller, but only one controller is shown in the photos.
